# Independent musical expectations (CC0 fixture)

`tempo-repeat-tie.musicxml` is an original 3-measure piano test:

- 1/8 pickup in 2/4 at quarter=80, then quarter=120.
- Three eighth-note triplets occupy one quarter note.
- Repeat measures 1–2 twice, following the pickup once (5 performed measures).
- G4 is tied across the measure boundary: one attack per repeat.
- D4 occurs in both hands at the same onset: one physical target, two anchors.

Expected full plan at quarter=80 (practice speed ratio 1 relative to initial tempo):
16 physical attacks, duration 4,375 ms; 0/375/1,375/2,375/3,375 ms measure starts.
Triplet onsets in the first repeat: 375, 541⅔, 708⅓ ms.
The first G4 attack starts at 875 ms and continues until 1,875 ms.
Practicing only the final written measure starts G4 with a new attack.

These expectations were calculated from written durations/tempo, independently
of the bridge and matcher. The original M0 fixture remains the baseline for
import/edit/save/export round trips.

## Expanded native corpus, 16 October 2026

Generated by `buildscripts/pianist/prepare-practice-corpus.py`; all compositions
are original CC0. `*-snapshot.json` files came from the real optimized WASM
engine through the diagnostic download control, with SVG pages removed and
project IDs made stable. They are not generated by the TypeScript plan builder.

| Fixture | Independently expected performed path (one-based bars) | Time at quarter=60 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| volta | 1, 2, 1, 3; C4 D4 C4 E4 | 4,000 ms |
| da-capo | 1, 2, 3, 1, 2; C4 D4 E4 C4 D4 | 5,000 ms |
| dal-segno-coda | 1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 3, 5; C4 D4 E4 F4 D4 E4 G4 | 7,000 ms |
| cross-staff | Right hand C4 D4 E4 F4; D/F rendered on lower staff, left C3 whole note | 4,000 ms |
| same-staff-voices | Voice 1 C4 D4 E4 F4; voice 2 G3 whole note on the same staff | 4,000 ms |
| special-symbols | C/E/G chord, D, E; grace B excluded, ornament main note only | 6,000 − 1,000/480 ms |

The fermata duration uses the native default stretch of 2 and MuseScore's reset
one tick before release (`Fraction::eps`); this is a renderer/playback policy,
not an assertion about expressive performance. Tests require all four policy
warnings (grace, ornament, arpeggio, fermata).

Volta, D.C. and D.S./Coda were exported to MXL and reimported in the browser;
semantic fingerprints and performed sequences were unchanged. D.C. initially
failed with inference disabled; the web importer now honors explicit MusicXML
navigation sound attributes. Text-only and numbered/multiple jump variants
remain outside this small corpus. Cross-staff tests distinguish source staff
for hand attribution from visual staff for highlight geometry.

## Articulation input fixture, updated 18 October 2026

`release-policy.musicxml` remains an original CC0 input with staccato C4,
staccatissimo D4, half-note E4, a descending C/E/G arpeggio and trill D4.
The obsolete snapshot and invented duration/arpeggio expectations were removed
with the V2 cutover. Native now exports raw articulations. This file supplies
notation input, not an oracle for musical duration or expression judgement.

## MPE reference captures, 24 October 2026

`special-symbols-mpe-snapshot.json` and `pedal-duration-mpe-snapshot.json` are
captures of the current optimized native engine, taken by
`tests/browser/pianist/two-staff-upgrade.cjs`. The runner compares every MPE
pitch/onset/offset/source identity against the real sample-playback event list
and checks SVG keys, then strips the SVG strings from the stored snapshots.
These supplement the historical written-note snapshots above; grace and
ornament expansions now participate in both Wait and BPM grading.
